purpose: Prepare, but do not execute, a controlled maintenance-window qualification that migrates the existing zhongshu Feishu entrance from the OpenClaw Core Binding to the Project Feishu Gateway.
prohibited_actions: stop or edit the current zhongshu Core Feishu Binding
start, stop, or restart a production Project Feishu Gateway
connect to Feishu or OpenClaw RPC
send a real Feishu message, attachment, or card
read or record credentials, tokens, or raw Feishu identifiers
rollback: Preparation-only work has no runtime state to restore. The produced rollback plan is for a separately authorized maintenance window.
secrets: Only sanitized operator snapshots are accepted by the new scripts; reports and test fixtures contain no credentials or raw Feishu identifiers.
